SITE NOTES / FIRST EDITION

Colophon.

The code, typefaces, and design of this site.

ON THIS PAGE
DesignTypeBuildAccess & motionIterations

Design

A field notebook with a little of a game engine’s inspection view. The dark olive background relates to the warm paper and olive palette of my portfolio. Fine rules and numbered entries do most of the organising.

The lab has space to show an experiment. Notes use a quieter reading layout. The two don’t need to look like the same set of cards.

Type

Public Sans handles headings and reading text. IBM Plex Mono is used for dates, entry numbers, and small technical annotations. Both are open-source fonts, served from this site as WOFF2 files. The italic on the homepage uses Georgia from the device’s system fonts.

Build

A small Node.js script renders shared templates into complete HTML pages. There’s no framework runtime, database, or client-side router. The spring experiment is an isolated JavaScript module; the rest is HTML and CSS.

Its graph uses the analytic solution for a damped spring. The same function draws the static curve and moves the interactive marker.

The source is on GitHub ↗

Access & motion

All writing and navigation work without JavaScript. The experiment includes a static diagram and explanation as its fallback. Keyboard focus is visible, controls use native buttons and inputs, and the mobile navigation stays in view without a menu toggle.

Motion starts only when requested. With reduced motion enabled, the experiment shows its final position immediately. Fonts are hosted locally, and this site doesn’t add analytics, tracking cookies, or third-party embeds.

Iterations

September 2026 — first edition of the notebook and lab, with the spring response study and an entry on the RFID platformer.
